english.title: Use a prohibited means to capture / kill a Schedule 4 / European protected species animal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of capturing or killing

(A)_[a wild mammal,]_
(B)_[wild mammals,]_

of a

(C)_[species listed in Schedule 4 to]_
(D)_[ a European protected species, where the capturing or killing of such animals is permitted in accordance with]_

the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017, namely **(..SPECIFY MAMMAL OR MAMMALS..), used

(E)_[blind or mutilated animals as live decoys]_
(F)_[tape recorders]_
(G)_[electrical and electronic devices capable of killing or stunning]_
(H)_[artificial light sources]_
(I)_[mirrors or other dazzling devices]_
(J)_[devices for illuminating targets]_
(K)_[sighting devices for night shooting comprising an electronic image magnifier or image converter]_
(L)_[explosives]_
(M)_[nets which were non-selective according to their principle or their conditions of use]_
(N)_[traps which were non-selective according to their principle or their conditions of use]_
(O)_[crossbows]_
(P)_[poisons and poisoned or anaesthetic bait]_
(Q)_[gassing or smoking out]_
(R)_[semi-automatic weapons with a magazine capable of holding more than two rounds of ammunition]_
(S)_[automatic weapons with a magazine capable of holding more than two rounds of ammunition]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 45(2)(a), (3) and (6) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Schedule 4 to the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 lists animals which may not be captured or killed in certain ways.
(ii) MoPI notes: this offence may be MoPI Group 3 where no animal cruelty or weapons are involved. Manual review recommended.
